title: InfiniteChallenge
description: Data Pack that provides a challenge for the 20w14infinite version.
body:
The main goal is to reach the The End dimension, but it is all up to the player what the real goal is.

The player will spawn inside a chamber with a small amount of portals.

Each portal is a one way dimension. After wandering around the portal will be deactivated. It gives time for the player to choose the home dimension since some can cause game crashes and/or photosensitivity triggers.

The player can return to the portal hub whenever going to the reset dimension: The Nether.
